text: Paragraph 1. This sentence is deliberately long enough that the terminal has to wrap it across several rows of the screen, which is the whole point of the fixture: a buffer row that is three or four screen rows is what the caret arithmetic used to get wrong, and what a page of scrolling has to be counted in.
